    pendingGameOverText - Variable in class application.Main
    Result string ("YOU WIN!" or "YOU LOSE!") queued for the overlay.
    Pig - Class in models.enemies
    A powerful AoE enemy unit — very high HP, high damage, but slow.
    Pig() - Constructor for class models.enemies.Pig
    Constructs a Pig at the default enemy spawn position (X = 60) and loads its walk, attack, idle, and knockback sprites.
    playerUnits - Variable in class logic.BattleManager
     
    playResultMusic(String) - Method in class application.Main
    Stops the stage music and plays a one-shot win/lose result jingle.
    postGameFrame - Variable in class application.Main
    Frame counter that drives the post-game burst-explosion animation.
    previousMoney - Variable in class logic.MoneyManager
    Money cap of the previous level, used to compute the next level's cap.
    processAttackDamage() - Method in class models.base.Unit
    Applies Unit.attackDamage to all locked-in Unit.currentTargets.
